purpose: Frozen Agentic evaluation-set manifest for controlled version comparison.

review_scope.final: confirmed 24/24; cx-13 corrected and verified after index rebuild
review_scope.high_priority: AI-assisted review complete for all complex, multi-turn, partial-answer, refusal, live-data, injection, and authorization-boundary cases
review_scope.single_hop: confirmed 43/43 across the single-hop and final review records

review_sources.path: eval/reviews/最终验证集人工确认表.md
eval/reviews/高优先级题人工确认表.md

evaluation_contract.ragas: Only expected_action=answer rows with a reference answer that actually produced a non-fallback RAG answer, contexts, and final_decision=answer are eligible.
evaluation_contract.partial_answer: Use deterministic assertions for final_decision, citations, missing_aspects, and explicit gap disclosure; do not mix into answer correctness.
evaluation_contract.refusal: Use deterministic assertions for final_decision=refuse, no citations, and an approved non-fabricating refusal template.
evaluation_contract.live_data: Use deterministic assertions for final_decision=out_of_scope, no citations, and the fixed no-realtime-tool response.

comparison_rule: Compare versions only when this manifest and the recorded experiment conditions match. Any dataset, split, review-source, model, index, threshold, remediation, or environment change starts a new comparison series.
